papers.title: Context-Dependent FHIR Serialisation Strategies for Clinical LLM Deployment: A Multi-Layer Benchmark on UK Core Data
papers.translated_title: 面向临床大语言模型部署的上下文相关FHIR序列化策略：基于英国核心数据的多层基准测试
papers.author: Chong, J.
papers.summary: The choice of FHIR-to-text serialisation format significantly impacts clinical LLM quality (Kruskal-Wallis H=163.86, p<10^-33, delta=0.24 on a 5-point scale), yet remains unstudied as a clinical deployment variable. We present FHIRBench-UK, evaluating five large language models across six serialisation formats and three clinical tasks on 100 UK Core FHIR patient bundles (18,000 scored prompts across clean and perturbed cohorts). Our findings converge with independent work on open-weight models (Pator, 2026). The optimal format is context-dependent: raw_json dominates for clinical QA, hybrid_adaptive for clinical reasoning, and structured_markdown for summarisation. In 58% of model-task-complexity scenarios, raw_json is suboptimal. Model capability moderates format sensitivity: Claude Sonnet 4.5 shows 0.10-point sensitivity versus Llama 3.3's 0.39, making adaptive serialisation most valuable for budget-constrained deployments using mid-tier models. All findings replicate under clinically realistic data perturbation. The study additionally confirms a complete ranking inversion between token-level F1 and clinical quality (rho=-0.90), replicating US findings across UK Core profiles. We recommend task-aware serialisation routing as a zero-cost quality intervention for NHS FHIR-based LLM deployments.
papers.translated_summary: FHIR到文本序列化格式的选择显著影响临床大语言模型质量（Kruskal-Wallis H=163.86，p<10^-33，5分制上delta=0.24），但作为临床部署变量仍未得到研究。我们提出FHIRBench-UK，在100个UK Core FHIR患者数据包上评估五种大语言模型，涵盖六种序列化格式和三项临床任务（在干净和扰动队列中产生18,000个评分提示）。我们的发现与开放权重模型的独立研究（Pator, 2026）一致。最优格式依赖于上下文：raw_json在临床问答中占优，hybrid_adaptive在临床推理中占优，structured_markdown在总结任务中占优。在58%的模型-任务-复杂度场景中，raw_json并非最优。模型能力调节格式敏感性：Claude Sonnet 4.5显示0.10点的敏感性，而Llama 3.3为0.39，这使得自适应序列化对使用中端模型的预算受限部署最具价值。所有发现在临床现实数据扰动下均可复现。研究还确认了token级F1与临床质量之间存在完全排名反转（rho=-0.90），在UK Core配置文件中复现了美国发现。我们建议将任务感知的序列化路由作为NHS基于FHIR的大语言模型部署的零成本质量干预措施。

papers.title: Efficacy of Psychological self-monitoring and goal-setting Intervention in Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction Rehabilitation mid-phase: A Randomized Controlled Trial
papers.translated_title: 心理自我监测与目标设定干预在前交叉韧带重建康复中期的效果：一项随机对照试验
papers.author: Sorrentino, M.
papers.summary: Background: Despite achieving clinical stability, many athletes fail to reach their pre-injury level of activity following anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction due to unresolved psychological barriers. Factors such as kinesiophobia, low self-efficacy, and a lack of psychological readiness often persist even when physical milestones are met, creating a psychological gap in traditional rehabilitation. Current evidence suggests that addressing these modifiable deficits through targeted interventions is essential for a successful return to sport. Objective: This randomized controlled trial evaluated the impact of a structured psychological self-monitoring and goal-setting intervention on kinesiophobia, psychological readiness, and adherence during the mid-phase of ACLR rehabilitation. Methods: Twelve patients (N=12) in the mid-phase of ACLR recovery were randomized to receive either a 4-week integrated psychological intervention or standard-of-care physical therapy. The experimental protocol focused on goal setting, positive self-talk, and imagery skills previously shown to correlate with higher adherence to home-based exercise. Results: The analysis of the baseline demographics confirms that both groups were well-matched. The primary behavioral outcome was measured using the Rehabilitation Compliance Questionnaire, a 20-item scale assessing attendance, instruction following, intensity of effort, and communication. For the Intervention Group, the improvement did not reach statistical significance (p = 0.144). The Control Group showed a trend toward significance (p = 0.063). Conclusion: Implementing psychological self-monitoring and goal-setting during the mid-phase of ACLR rehabilitation addresses the biopsychosocial complexities of recovery. This approach potentially enhances the alignment between physical function and mental readiness, providing a more comprehensive pathway for athletes returning to pivoting sports
papers.translated_summary: 背景：尽管达到临床稳定，许多运动员在前交叉韧带重建术后因未解决的心理障碍而无法恢复到伤前活动水平。即使在达到身体里程碑后，运动恐惧症、低自我效能感和心理准备不足等因素仍常持续存在，在传统康复中形成心理缺口。现有证据表明，通过针对性干预解决这些可改变缺陷对于成功重返运动至关重要。目的：本随机对照试验评估了结构化心理自我监测与目标设定干预对ACLR康复中期运动恐惧症、心理准备度和依从性的影响。方法：将ACLR恢复中期的十二名患者（N=12）随机分配接受为期4周的综合心理干预或标准物理治疗。实验方案侧重于目标设定、积极自我对话和意象技能，这些此前已被证明与家庭锻炼的更高依从性相关。结果：基线人口统计学分析确认两组匹配良好。主要行为结果采用康复依从性问卷测量，该问卷为20项量表，评估出勤、指令遵循、努力强度和沟通。干预组的改善未达到统计学显著性（p = 0.144）。对照组显示出接近显著的趋势（p = 0.063）。结论：在ACLR康复中期实施心理自我监测和目标设定，可应对恢复过程中的生物心理社会复杂性。该方法可能增强身体功能与心理准备度之间的协调，为运动员重返旋转运动提供更全面的路径。

papers.title: Association of the EEG Correlate Of Injury to the Nervous System (COIN) Index with Focal Cerebral Injury in Children Receiving Extracorporeal Membrane Oxygenation
papers.translated_title: 脑电图神经系统损伤相关指数（COIN）与接受体外膜氧合儿童局灶性脑损伤的关联
papers.author: Ghasemzadeh, R.
papers.summary: BACKGROUND Children receiving extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (ECMO) are at high risk for focal cerebral injury (FCI). There is emerging evidence that electroencephalography (EEG) may aid FCI detection. The EEG Correlate of Injury to the Nervous System (COIN) index quantifies and displays focal background asymmetries. We evaluated whether COIN is associated with FCI in pediatric ECMO. METHODS Retrospective, cross-sectional study of patients age 28 days to 21 years, on venoarterial ECMO at a tertiary children's hospital, who received EEG monitoring and neuroimaging during ECMO. COIN was calculated from all available EEG data. COIN of 0 implies a symmetric EEG and negative COIN values are observed with FCI. Median COIN values near FCI recognition time were compared to median COIN values from randomly selected control EEG batches using logistic regression. A receiver operator characteristic curve was used to identify multilevel FCI test ranges. Likelihood ratios were calculated to estimate the posttest FCI probability for each COIN range. RESULTS During the 8-year study period (2015-2023), 33 of 142 ECMO runs met study criteria for COIN analysis. Twelve patients (36%) had FCI. The COIN cutoff of -13.3 had 92% sensitivity and 67% specificity for FCI. The COIN cutoff of -27.7 had 67% sensitivity and 90% specificity. Likelihood ratios were 0.13 for COIN (0 to -13.3), 1.1 for COIN (-13.3 to -27.7), and 7.0 for COIN (< -27.7). Posttest probability was 0.02, 0.13, 0.49 in each respective range. CONCLUSION FCI on ECMO is associated with COIN-measured EEG asymmetry. COIN may support FCI risk-stratification during ECMO.
papers.translated_summary: 背景 接受体外膜氧合（ECMO）的儿童发生局灶性脑损伤（FCI）的风险较高。新证据表明，脑电图（EEG）可能有助于FCI检测。神经系统损伤的EEG相关性（COIN）指数可量化并显示局灶性背景不对称性。我们评估了COIN是否与儿科ECMO中的FCI相关。方法 对三级儿童医院接受静脉-动脉ECMO、年龄在28天至21岁之间、并在ECMO期间接受EEG监测和神经影像检查的患者进行回顾性横断面研究。COIN从所有可用EEG数据中计算。COIN为0表示EEG对称，负COIN值见于FCI。将接近FCI识别时间的中位COIN值与随机选择的对照EEG批次的中位COIN值进行比较，采用逻辑回归分析。使用受试者工作特征曲线确定多级FCI测试范围。计算似然比以估计每个COIN范围的FCI后测概率。结果 在8年研究期间（2015-2023年），142次ECMO运行中有33次符合COIN分析的研究标准。12名患者（36%）有FCI。COIN截断值-13.3对FCI的敏感性为92%，特异性为67%。COIN截断值-27.7的敏感性为67%，特异性为90%。COIN（0至-13.3）的似然比为0.13，COIN（-13.3至-27.7）为1.1，COIN（<-27.7）为7.0。各范围的后测概率分别为0.02、0.13和0.49。结论 ECMO期间的FCI与COIN测量的EEG不对称性相关。COIN可能支持ECMO期间的FCI风险分层。

papers.title: Diffuse generalized phenotype of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy: genetic spectrum and surgical correction
papers.translated_title: 弥漫性肥厚型心肌病的广泛表型：遗传谱系与外科矫正
papers.author: Dzemeshkevich, S. L.
papers.summary: Introduction. Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) is characterized by clinical and genetic heterogeneity. Age of manifestation, clinical and anatomical phenotypes of HCM vary significantly. This study discusses genetic causes and reconstructive surgery results for patients with particular intracardiac phenotype - diffused generalized HCM (DG-HCM). Methods: personal and familial medical history, general examination, 12-lead resting ECG, 24-hour ECG Holter monitoring, transthoracic and transesophageal EchoCG, cardiac MRI with gadolinium enhancement. A ten-gene panel was sequenced by IonTorrent PGM. Mutational screening in patients with suspected multisystemic diseases was performed by Sanger sequencing. Results: 170 patients with obstructive HCM (oHCM) requesting genetic counseling and surgical correction of HCM were evaluated. We distinguished particular DG-HCM subtype of oHCM (diffuse hypertrophy of IVS, LV free walls, papillary muscles displaced towards the LV apex) in 34 patients; 31 out of 34 underwent open heart reconstructive surgery. Patients with DG-HCM were younger at the time of surgery, had higher risk of SCD, and connective tissue dysplasia of the mitral valve. Hemodynamics normalization was observed in 1, 3, and 5 years after surgery. Eighteen ICDs were implanted; five patients experienced appropriate shocks. The genetic spectrum was enriched up to 30% by multisystem disorders. Mutations in "sarcomeric" genes were detected in 15%. Conclusion: Intracardiac phenotype of HCM may correlate with genetic cause and long-term prognosis. DG-HCM phenotype accounts for 20% oHCM patients and indications for open-heart surgery. Extended myectomy with parietal resection of papillary muscles and correction of mitral valve insufficiency provides long-term benefits for DG-HCM patients. Multisystem disorders in patients with DG-HCM should be of special attention. Study was supported by research project FURG-2024-0004.
papers.translated_summary: 引言：肥厚型心肌病（HCM）以临床和遗传异质性为特征。发病年龄、临床及解剖表型差异显著。本研究探讨特定心内表型——弥漫性广泛性HCM（DG-HCM）患者的遗传病因及重建手术结果。方法：收集个人及家族病史、一般检查、12导联静息心电图、24小时心电图Holter监测、经胸及经食管超声心动图、钆增强心脏MRI。采用IonTorrent PGM对十基因面板进行测序。对疑似多系统疾病患者通过Sanger测序进行突变筛查。结果：评估了170例梗阻性HCM（oHCM）患者，均寻求遗传咨询及手术矫正。在34例患者中识别出特定DG-HCM亚型（室间隔、左室游离壁弥漫性肥厚，乳头肌向心尖移位）；34例中31例接受开放性心脏重建手术。DG-HCM患者手术时年龄较轻，心脏性猝死风险较高，并伴有二尖瓣结缔组织发育不良。术后1、3、5年观察到血流动力学正常化。植入18台ICD；5例患者经历适当电击。遗传谱因多系统疾病扩展至30%。“肌节”基因突变检出率为15%。结论：HCM心内表型可能与遗传病因及长期预后相关。DG-HCM表型占oHCM患者的20%，并构成开放性手术指征。扩大肌切除术联合乳头肌壁部分切除及二尖瓣关闭不全矫正为DG-HCM患者提供长期获益。DG-HCM患者中的多系统疾病应予以特别关注。研究由科研项目FURG-2024-0004资助。

papers.title: Analysis of spliceosome-related coding and noncoding genes and pseudogenes reveals novel candidates
papers.translated_title: 剪接体相关编码基因、非编码基因及假基因的分析揭示了新的候选基因
papers.author: Messaoud, O.
papers.summary: Splicing is a complex molecular mechanism in eukaryotic cells essential to gene expression and regulation, involving more than 300 protein-coding genes (PCGs) and 43 small nuclear RNA (snRNA) genes. However, fewer than 30 gene-disease relationships have been described as spliceosomopathies to date. This discrepancy suggests the splicing machinery as an underexplored area for human disease gene discovery. For snRNA currently classified as pseudogenes, we prioritized candidates with similar epigenomic, genomic, and hypermutability features as functional snRNA genes. Population-variant-depletion analysis was performed to identify regions under negative selection. We analyzed rare variants in PCGs and snRNA genes and prioritized snRNA pseudogenes across a large heterogeneous rare disease cohort. There was high concordance for prioritizing genes annotated as pseudogenes by the variant-depleted region analysis (9) and by random forest models of hypermutation, genomic and epigenomic features (6). We identified 26 variants of interest across six PCGs with established gene-disease relationships (GDRs) and 14 genes not yet disease-associated, including one pseudogene across 30 individuals. For snRNAs genes, we identified 49 variants of interest located in seven genes with established GDR and 11 genes not yet disease-associated, including two pseudogenes across 80 individuals. This study highlights the importance of splicing-related PCG and snRNA in the genetic etiology of rare diseases. By leveraging specialized approaches for prioritizing pseudogenes, combined with the PCG and snRNA analysis, the genes and variants expand the variant pathogenicity spectrum of spliceosomopathies and suggest variants for follow-up case series and future functional validation.
papers.translated_summary: 剪接是真核细胞中一个复杂的分子机制，对基因表达和调控至关重要，涉及超过300个蛋白质编码基因（PCGs）和43个小核RNA（snRNA）基因。然而，迄今为止，被描述为剪接体病的基因-疾病关系不到30种。这一差异表明剪接机制是人类疾病基因发现中尚未充分探索的领域。对于目前被归类为假基因的snRNA，我们优先考虑了具有与功能性snRNA基因相似的表观基因组、基因组和超突变特征的候选基因。进行了群体变异耗竭分析，以识别处于负选择下的区域。我们分析了大型异质性罕见疾病队列中PCGs和snRNA基因的罕见变异，并优先考虑了snRNA假基因。通过变异耗竭区域分析（9个）和基于超突变、基因组及表观基因组特征的随机森林模型（6个）优先考虑的假基因注释基因之间具有高度一致性。我们在六个具有既定基因-疾病关系（GDRs）的PCGs和十四个尚未与疾病关联的基因中识别出26个感兴趣的变异，其中包括一个假基因，涉及30名个体。对于snRNA基因，我们在七个具有既定GDR的基因和十一个尚未与疾病关联的基因中识别出49个感兴趣的变异，其中包括两个假基因，涉及80名个体。本研究强调了剪接相关PCG和snRNA在罕见疾病遗传病因学中的重要性。通过利用专门的方法优先考虑假基因，并结合PCG和snRNA分析，这些基因和变异扩展了剪接体病的变异致病性谱，并为后续病例系列和未来功能验证提供了变异建议。

papers.title: Multi-ancestry admixture mapping reveals ancestry-associated disease loci in the UK Biobank
papers.translated_title: 多祖先混合图谱揭示了英国生物库中与祖先相关的疾病位点
papers.author: smeriglio, R.
papers.summary: Genome-wide association studies have successfully identified thousands of genetic associations, yet their predominant reliance on European-descent populations limits insights into the full spectrum of human genetic diversity and its impact on disease. Admixture mapping offers a powerful, complementary approach by leveraging differences in haplotype frequencies across ancestral backgrounds to identify risk loci for complex traits. Here, we perform a large-scale, multi-ancestry admixture mapping study across 415,792 unrelated individuals in the UK Biobank, examining associations between local haplotype ancestry and 108 phenotypes. Our approach identifies 13 genome-wide significant ancestry-phenotype associations, recovering previously reported signals while uncovering four novel ancestry-associated findings, including new risk loci for atrial fibrillation, dermatitis, and angina pectoris. To overcome the limited resolution of traditional admixture mapping, we implemented a conditional fine-mapping framework, which enabled us to localize four putatively causal variants. In silico variant effect prediction and eQTL integration revealed regulatory and missense effects predominantly localized to lung, and immune tissues, aligning with captured phenotypes such as asthma, dermatitis, and hypothyroidism. Notably, our findings demonstrate striking genetic heterogeneity, revealing how the same clinical phenotype can arise through distinct genetic pathways depending on the ancestral background. Overall, this work highlights the critical importance of modeling local ancestry structure to refine genetic associations, uncover novel disease mechanisms, and improve the equitable translation of genomic medicine.
papers.translated_summary: 全基因组关联研究已成功识别出数千个遗传关联，但其主要依赖欧洲裔人群，限制了对人类遗传多样性全谱及其对疾病影响的洞察。混合图谱定位通过利用不同祖先背景间单倍型频率的差异来识别复杂性状的风险位点，提供了一种强大的补充方法。在此，我们针对英国生物银行中415,792名无亲缘关系个体开展了一项大规模、多祖先混合图谱定位研究，检验局部单倍型祖先与108种表型之间的关联。我们的方法识别出13个全基因组显著的祖先-表型关联，恢复了先前报道的信号，同时发现了四项新的祖先相关发现，包括心房颤动、皮炎和心绞痛的新风险位点。为克服传统混合图谱定位分辨率有限的不足，我们实施了一种条件精细定位框架，从而定位了四个推定因果变异。计算机模拟变异效应预测和eQTL整合揭示了主要定位于肺和免疫组织的调控及错义效应，与所捕获的表型如哮喘、皮炎和甲状腺功能减退相一致。值得注意的是，我们的发现展示了显著的遗传异质性，揭示同一临床表型如何根据祖先背景通过不同遗传途径产生。总体而言，这项工作强调了建模局部祖先结构对于细化遗传关联、揭示新疾病机制以及改善基因组医学公平转化的关键重要性。

papers.title: Real-World Performance of the 2026 AHA/ACC Pulmonary Embolism Framework in a Multi-System CTPA Cohort
papers.translated_title: 2026年AHA/ACC肺栓塞框架在多系统CTPA队列中的真实世界表现
papers.author: Alwakeel, M.
papers.summary: Background: The 2026 American Heart Association/American College of Cardiology (AHA/ACC) guidelines replaced the 2019 European Society of Cardiology (ESC) four-tier pulmonary embolism (PE) risk scheme with five clinical categories (A-E) and subcategories. These categories were set by expert consensus and have not been validated against outcomes. How patients are reclassified relative to ESC, or how the two systems compare prognostically, is unknown. Methods: We utilized three cohorts of patients with confirmed PE using structured electronic health record data, laboratory biomarkers, and large-language-model abstraction of radiology reports: Duke University Health System (n=12,992, drawn from 95,760 consecutive inpatient CT pulmonary angiography studies, 2014-2025, with no referral or registry enrollment step between imaging and cohort entry), INSPECT (Stanford; n=3,870), and MIMIC-IV (Beth Israel Deaconess; n=361). Patients were assigned AHA/ACC categories B through E, subcategorized where data allowed, and mapped to 2019 ESC risk strata. The primary outcome was 30-day mortality; discrimination was assessed with Harrell C-index. Results: Among 17,223 patients with confirmed PE, pooled 30-day mortality rose monotonically across categories: 1.5% (B), 8.9% (C), 15.5% (D), and 31.9% (E), with the ordering preserved in all three cohorts despite differing baseline mortality. Subcategory-level discrimination was reliable only at the high-acuity extreme (D2-E2); across subcategories C1 through D1, mortality did not order monotonically (9.2%, 10.8%, 8.1%, 10.9%), and adding subcategories to category C did not improve discrimination at Duke (C-index 0.699 vs 0.699). Category C patients lacking both echocardiography and biomarker testing (12.7% of category C) had mortality (10.4%) equal to or exceeding classified peers. Relative to ESC, the frameworks were concordant at the extremes, but 5.7%of ESC intermediate-risk patients were reclassified to category D, with modestly higher but non-significant 30-day mortality than those remaining in category C (10.8% versus 8.9%). Conclusions: Across a three-health-system cohort, the 2026 AHA/ACC framework produced a reproducible mortality gradient at the category level, with added subcategory granularity refining risk chiefly at the highest-acuity tiers. Discrimination across the broad intermediate band was limited, and reclassification from ESC fell almost entirely within this range.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：2026年美国心脏协会/美国心脏病学会（AHA/ACC）指南以五个临床类别（A-E）及亚类取代了2019年欧洲心脏病学会（ESC）的四级肺栓塞（PE）风险分层方案。这些类别由专家共识设定，尚未针对临床结局进行验证。患者相对于ESC如何被重新分类，或两种系统在预后方面的比较效果，目前未知。方法：我们利用三个确诊PE患者队列，基于结构化电子健康记录数据、实验室生物标志物及大语言模型对放射学报告的抽象提取：杜克大学健康系统（n=12,992，来自2014-2025年间95,760例连续住院CT肺动脉造影研究，影像检查与队列入组之间无转诊或注册步骤）、INSPECT（斯坦福；n=3,870）及MIMIC-IV（贝斯以色列女执事医疗中心；n=361）。患者被分配至AHA/ACC类别B至E，在数据允许处进行亚类划分，并映射至2019年ESC风险分层。主要结局为30天死亡率；判别能力通过Harrell C指数评估。结果：在17,223例确诊PE患者中，合并30天死亡率随类别单调上升：1.5%（B）、8.9%（C）、15.5%（D）和31.9%（E），尽管三个队列的基线死亡率不同，但排序在所有队列中保持一致。亚类水平的判别仅在高度急性极端（D2-E2）可靠；在亚类C1至D1之间，死亡率未呈单调排序（9.2%、10.8%、8.1%、10.9%），且在杜克队列中，向类别C添加亚类未改善判别能力（C指数0.699对0.699）。缺乏超声心动图和生物标志物检测的类别C患者（占类别C的12.7%）的死亡率（10.4%）等于或超过已分类的同类患者。相对于ESC，两种框架在极端情况下一致，但5.7%的ESC中危患者被重新分类至类别D，其30天死亡率略高但无显著差异，相较于留在类别C的患者（10.8%对8.9%）。结论：在三个医疗系统队列中，2026年AHA/ACC框架在类别水平上产生了可复现的死亡率梯度，新增的亚类粒度主要在最高急性度层级细化风险。广泛中间带的判别能力有限，且来自ESC的重新分类几乎完全落在此范围内。

papers.title: Livestock production intensity and mucosal IgA and IgG responses to H5N1 highly pathogenic avian influenza A virus, North Carolina, 2021-2022
papers.translated_title: 2021-2022年北卡罗来纳州牲畜生产强度与H5N1高致病性禽流感A病毒黏膜IgA和IgG反应
papers.author: Pisanic, N.
papers.summary: Background. Direct livestock exposure is a risk factor for zoonotic influenza, including H5N1 highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) A virus. But whether living in regions of high poultry and swine production intensity (PPI, SPI) increases risk of exposure to zoonotic influenza viruses independent of occupational livestock contact remains unclear. Objectives. To determine whether livestock workers and community members with no occupational livestock exposure in North Carolina, where poultry and swine production are increasingly co-located, are at higher risk of exposure to zoonotic influenza. Methods. Saliva samples from industrial livestock operation worker (ILO-W), ILO neighbor (ILO-N) and metropolitan area (Metro) households were analyzed for mucosal influenza A (H5N1, H1N1, and H3N2) hemagglutinin (HA) IgA and IgG antibodies to determine associations of PPI, SPI, exposure group, and detection of a swine-specific fecal contamination marker (Pig-2-Bac DNA) with influenza A antibody levels. Results. Residing in the highest PPI and SPI tertile was associated with significantly higher mucosal H5 and H1 HA IgA levels, including among residents without occupational livestock exposure. Households with occupational poultry or swine contact had significantly higher H5 IgA and IgG and H1 IgA levels compared to Metro households. In regression models accounting for clustering at the participant level, log10 anti-H5 HA mucosal IgA increased 0.16 (95% CI: 0.06, 0.27, p<0.005) and 0.10 (95% CI: 0.03, 0.17, p<0.005), per log10 increase in PPI and SPI, respectively, and 0.16 (95% CI: 0.03, 0.19, p<0.02) when Pig-2-Bac DNA was detected on household surfaces. Conclusions. Mucosal H5 HA IgA and IgG and H1 HA IgA were consistently elevated across different metrics of livestock exposure intensity, including residential exposure, occupational contact within a household, and a molecular marker of household swine fecal contamination in a state with intensive poultry and swine production.
papers.translated_summary: 背景。直接接触牲畜是人畜共患流感（包括H5N1高致病性禽流感（HPAI）A病毒）的风险因素。但在家禽和生猪生产密集度（PPI、SPI）高的地区居住，是否会在职业性牲畜接触之外独立增加人畜共患流感病毒的暴露风险，仍不清楚。目的。确定北卡罗来纳州（该州家禽和生猪生产日益集中）的牲畜工人和无职业性牲畜接触的社区成员是否面临更高的人畜共患流感暴露风险。方法。对工业化牲畜经营工人（ILO-W）、ILO邻居（ILO-N）和大都市区（Metro）住户的唾液样本进行黏膜流感A（H5N1、H1N1和H3N2）血凝素（HA）IgA和IgG抗体分析，以确定PPI、SPI、暴露组以及猪特异性粪便污染标志物（Pig-2-Bac DNA）的检测与流感A抗体水平的关联。结果。居住在最PPI和SPI三分位区与显著较高的黏膜H5和H1 HA IgA水平相关，包括在无职业性牲畜接触的居民中。有职业性家禽或猪接触的住户与Metro住户相比，其H5 IgA和IgG及H1 IgA水平显著更高。在考虑参与者水平聚类的回归模型中，log10抗H5 HA黏膜IgA随PPI和SPI每增加一个log10分别增加0.16（95% CI：0.06，0.27，p<0.005）和0.10（95% CI：0.03，0.17，p<0.005），当住户表面检测到Pig-2-Bac DNA时增加0.16（95% CI：0.03，0.19，p<0.02）。结论。在密集家禽和生猪生产的州，黏膜H5 HA IgA和IgG及H1 HA IgA在不同牲畜暴露强度指标下持续升高，包括居住暴露、住户内职业接触以及住户猪粪便污染分子标志物。

papers.title: Implementation of a Multimodal Diagnostic Algorithm for Blood Culture-Negative Infective Endocarditis at the Argentine National Reference Laboratory: A Prospective Study
papers.translated_title: 阿根廷国家参考实验室血液培养阴性感染性心内膜炎多模态诊断算法的实施：一项前瞻性研究
papers.author: Armitano, R.
papers.summary: Background: Blood culture-negative infective endocarditis (BCNIE) poses a significant diagnostic challenge. This study evaluated a multimodal diagnostic algorithm combining serological and molecular methods at the Argentine National Reference Laboratory. Methods: A prospective analysis was conducted on 53 consecutive patients with suspected BCNIE referred between January 2019 and December 2024. The diagnostic workflow included indirect immunofluorescence for Bartonella spp. and Coxiella burnetii, species-specific PCR for Bartonella spp. and Tropheryma whipplei, and broad-range 16S rRNA PCR with Sanger sequencing on available blood and valvular tissue specimens. Results: An etiological diagnosis was established in 17 of 53 patients (32.1%). Bartonella spp. was the predominant pathogen (47.1%; 8/17), followed by T. whipplei (35.3%; 6/17) and Streptococcus spp. (17.6%; 3/17). All Bartonella cases were initially detected via serology, with molecular confirmation achieved exclusively through valvular tissue analysis. Conclusions: Implementing a standardized multimodal diagnostic algorithm significantly enhances etiological yields in BCNIE. The findings emphasize the complementary value of frontline serology and targeted molecular testing, highlighting that simultaneous submission of serum, blood, and valvular tissue is essential for optimal diagnosis.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：血培养阴性感染性心内膜炎（BCNIE）构成重大诊断挑战。本研究在阿根廷国家参考实验室评估了一种结合血清学和分子方法的多模式诊断算法。方法：对2019年1月至2024年12月期间转诊的53例疑似BCNIE连续患者进行前瞻性分析。诊断流程包括针对巴尔通体属和伯氏考克斯体的间接免疫荧光法、针对巴尔通体属和惠普尔养障体的种特异性PCR，以及针对可用血液和瓣膜组织标本的广谱16S rRNA PCR联合Sanger测序。结果：53例患者中有17例（32.1%）确定了病原学诊断。巴尔通体属为主要病原体（47.1%；8/17），其次为惠普尔养障体（35.3%；6/17）和链球菌属（17.6%；3/17）。所有巴尔通体病例均通过血清学初步检出，分子确认仅通过瓣膜组织分析实现。结论：实施标准化多模式诊断算法显著提高了BCNIE的病原学检出率。研究结果强调了前线血清学与靶向分子检测的互补价值，并指出同时提交血清、血液和瓣膜组织对于最佳诊断至关重要。

papers.title: Minimal measurement strategies for cardiometabolic risk classification within the Positive Health framework: A cross-sectional analysis of NHANES 1999-2004 data
papers.translated_title: Positive Health框架下心血管代谢风险分类的最小测量策略：NHANES 1999-2004数据的横断面分析
papers.author: Schorr, K.
papers.summary: Background: Large-scale prevention and population health monitoring require measurement approaches that are both feasible and informative. Although several self-measurable anthropometric and fitness indicators have been associated with cardiometabolic risk, it remains unclear whether combining multiple measurements provides meaningful improvements over simpler approaches. We evaluated whether a parsimonious set of self-measurable indicators can achieve classification performance comparable to a full candidate set and quantified the incremental value of additional measurements. Methods: Using data from 8,275 adults in the NHANES 1999-2004 cohorts, we evaluated a predefined minimal set of four self-measurable anthropometric and fitness indicators (body mass index (BMI), waist-to-height ratio (WHtR), mid-upper arm circumference (MUAC), and VO2max (as a proxy for the 6-minute walk test) as candidate indicators of cardiometabolic risk. Their ability to reflect underlying clinical risk factors related to adiposity, glucose and lipid metabolism, and physical fitness was assessed using nested logistic regression models, likelihood ratio tests, discrimination metrics, and decision tree analyses. Results: WHtR consistently showed the strongest discriminative performance, with {Delta}PR-AUC values for BMI versus WHtR ranging from -0.002 to -0.037, and emerged as the primary splitting variable. Adding BMI to WHtR resulted in small gains in PR-AUC for most outcomes, ranging from 0.000 to 0.008, except for triglycerides where the gain was larger ({Delta}PR-AUC=0.039). Further inclusion of MUAC and VO2max provided limited additional value overall, with evidence of variation across outcomes and sex stratified analyses. Conclusion: Most classification performance was achieved using a limited number of simple self-measurable indicators, with little additional benefit from incorporating further measurements. These findings suggest that parsimonious measurement strategies may provide a feasible approach for cardiometabolic risk classification in population health and prevention settings while reducing measurement burden.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：大规模预防和人群健康监测需要既可行又信息丰富的测量方法。尽管多种可自我测量的身体和体能指标已与心脏代谢风险相关联，但尚不清楚组合多种测量是否比简单方法带来有意义的改进。我们评估了一组精简的可自我测量指标是否能达到与完整候选集相当的分类性能，并量化了额外测量的增量价值。方法：利用NHANES 1999-2004队列中8,275名成年人的数据，我们评估了一组预定义的四个可自我测量身体和体能指标（体重指数（BMI）、腰高比（WHtR）、中上臂围（MUAC）和VO2max（作为6分钟步行测试的代理））作为心脏代谢风险的候选指标。它们反映与肥胖、葡萄糖和脂质代谢以及体能相关的潜在临床风险因素的能力，通过嵌套逻辑回归模型、似然比检验、判别度量和决策树分析进行评估。结果：WHtR始终表现出最强的判别性能，BMI与WHtR的{Delta}PR-AUC值范围从-0.002到-0.037，并成为主要的分裂变量。将BMI添加到WHtR中，对大多数结局的PR-AUC有小幅提升，范围从0.000到0.008，但甘油三酯除外，其增益更大（{Delta}PR-AUC=0.039）。进一步纳入MUAC和VO2max总体上提供的额外价值有限，且存在跨结局和性别分层分析的变异证据。结论：大多数分类性能通过有限数量的简单可自我测量指标即可实现，纳入更多测量带来的额外益处很小。这些发现表明，精简的测量策略可能为人群健康和预防环境中的心脏代谢风险分类提供可行方法，同时减少测量负担。
